items.content_html:
Reasons:

since DEs like KDE Plasma 6, GNOME and COMSIC are not designed to be x11-exclusive putting them under services.xserver is misleading; to confirm my point - this PR and this PR exist.
also, GNOME's default is wayland, and x11 sessions is an option, that could be dropped in future.

items.content_html:
fan2go is a simple daemon providing dynamic fan speed control based on temperature sensors. While we had it packaged in nixpkgs for some time, it's usage is as a daemon, so having module seems natural to me.

I've deployed it to my homelab and it seems to be working just fine. As the daemon has to be running as root, I've removed most of sandboxing in systemd service config, if someone more knowledgeable in the area wants more restricted permissions, please show me an example.

items.content_html:
mptcpd is a daemon that manager mptcp path like ip mptcp do

ip mptcp endpoint add 192.168.1.100 dev eth0 subflow
ip mptcp endpoint add 10.0.0.4 dev wwan0 subflow
ip mptcp limit set subflow 5

Mptcpd can be configured via configFile or command line options, however the default configfile live in /nix/store does not set subflow flags nor detect iface by default. Thus an extra mptcpdFlags option is needed.

The provided example extraMptcpdFlags

        example = [
          "--addr-flags=subflow"
          "--notify-flags=existing,skip_link_local,skip_loopback,check_route"
        ];

is suitable for endpoint router settings and manager mptcp path similar to what the NetworkManager does.

Users can follow the redhet instruction Chapter 35. Getting started with Multipath TCP to test for mptcp.
